ios.desc:
ListenInstead wants to solve a big problem.

  
THE PROBLEM
We all have too much to read, and not enough time.
 

THE SOLUTION
ListenInstead - the only platform with free, human-read audio content.
 
 
HOW IT WORKS (it’s easy)
 
For Listeners…
Search audio content by publisher, category or keyword.  Hit play and become smarter and better informed faster than ever before.
 
For Publishers…
You publish written content on the Internet, and it’s amazing. Give your readers the wonderful gift of audio, they’ll love you for it. Here’s how it works:
 
1.       Upload your audio or use our simple in-app recording studio.
2.       Pair with a great photo (we highly recommend Unsplash.com) and headline, and hit Publish. 
3.       We’ll automatically email an embed code you can use to place the ListenInstead Player on your website for on-page listening.
4.       Easily monetize your channel by adding sponsor messages and graphics.
 
 
WHY WE EXIST
To convert the written word into audio for the benefit of all.
 
 
IN CONCLUSION
·       Time is limited, we want to give you more of it.
·       For publishers, your written content is too good not to be in audio.
·       Robots are great at lots of things, but reading isn’t one of them. #sorryrobots
·       The human voice is magic, and human connection is more important now than ever before.
·       We love you, fellow human. Seriously.
 
This description is intentionally short. See? We’re saving you time already!
 
Download and start listening (or recording) now.
